system: You are an intent classifier for SpotifyCares's customer-support inbox. Classify the customer's message into exactly one intent from the taxonomy. Judge from the customer's message alone. Respond with only a JSON object.
prompt:
TAXONOMY (choose exactly one `name`):
- content_availability: A specific song, album, artist, podcast or version is missing, removed, not yet released, region-locked, unplayable on every client, or has wrong metadata; or Spotify is not launched in the customer's country.
    includes: 'add X', 'where is X', 'why was X removed', 'when is X coming', 'X not available in my country'; a named title greyed out on ALL clients; wrong artist page/credits reported by a listener; fan petitions and new-release waiting; 'when will Spotify come to India'.
    excludes: Customer's OWN library/downloads vanished, or everything greyed out on one device -> app_or_playback_issue. 'my song/my release' -> artist_and_creator. Existing account blocked abroad/VPN -> account_access_and_settings. Opinions about editorial playlists -> feature_request_and_feedback.
    e.g. "add teen, age by svt please"
    e.g. "why aren't the Jonas Brother's available in my country? pls im really concerned thanks"
- billing_and_subscription: Money has moved or the paid-plan state is wrong or must be changed: unexpected/duplicate charges, refunds, paid-but-still-Free, ads on a stated Premium account, promo/trial charged wrongly, payment failing at checkout, cancelling to stop payments, and Family/Student/Hulu/partner plan membership FAILURES.
    includes: Charged twice; charged after cancelling; 'says I only have a free account'; Premium on the wrong login; card declined at checkout; errors on the payment page while logged in; change billing date; cancel to stop payments; Family invite errors; student discount expired on a live subscription; Hulu bundle not working; merging two paid accounts.
    excludes: Cannot log in at all (even to cancel) -> account_access_and_settings. Plan/policy questions with a fixed public answer and no failed attempt or charge ('how much is yearly', 'can two people share Premium', 'how do I verify as a student') -> how_to_and_product_question. Ads with no Premium/paid wording -> feature_request_and_feedback.
    e.g. "second month in a row I've been charged for premium but my account is still "free""
    e.g. "why'd I get charged twice this month, once for normal 10 second for 15"
- account_access_and_settings: The customer cannot get into, create or identify their own account on any client, or needs a backstage change to account identity or settings (email, country, username, Facebook link, merge, marketing opt-out), with no sign of a third party.
    includes: 'can't log in' with no working device mentioned; 'too many redirects'/token errors on the LOGIN page; Facebook auth errors; password reset email never arrives; forgot email/username; sign-up stuck; account locked or 'deleted itself'; change account email/country; unsubscribe from marketing emails; location enforcement on an existing account (abroad, 14-day limit, VPN).
    excludes: Someone else using the account or attacker changed the email -> account_security. Logged in but Premium not recognised or payment-page error -> billing_and_subscription. Login fails on ONE device while others work, 'you're offline' at login -> app_or_playback_issue.
    e.g. "can't login! Too many redirects error message"
    e.g. "i lost access to the email account linked to my account. how do i update it if i cannot log in or get a password reset?"
- account_security: The customer believes an unknown third party has or is using their account, an attacker changed their details, or they are checking whether a security email or breach claim is legitimate.
    includes: 'I got hacked', 'hijacked', 'compromised'; unknown music in Recently Played; unknown device/location; music switching to an unknown speaker; 'paused because your account is being used somewhere else' with no known co-listener; email/password changed without consent; 'is this phishing?'; a deceased person's account.
    excludes: Plain forgotten password with no third-party sign -> account_access_and_settings. A known person (partner, family) sharing the account -> how_to_and_product_question. Unfamiliar songs only in Discover Weekly/suggestions -> feature_request_and_feedback.
    e.g. "I swear my Spotify got hacked by someone. Whoever did it deleted all my playlists and were listening to their own music look!"
    e.g. "Someone is definitely using my Spotify I have no idea what this music is or why it's in my recently played"
- app_or_playback_issue: The app or playback misbehaves on the customer's device or client: crashes, won't open, skipping, tracks won't play, downloads or library disappearing, queue/shuffle/autoplay malfunction, car/speaker/console/web-player integration failures, a device-scoped login failure, or a suspected outage.
    includes: Any symptom tied to a device, OS, browser, car, speaker, console or update; 'is Spotify down?'; ads in the wrong language; 30-minute ad-free window resetting; downloads unexpectedly removed; playlists/library gone; playback stops after every song; login fails on one device only; 'you're offline' at login.
    excludes: Cannot log in on any client -> account_access_and_settings. 'Says I need Premium' or ads on a stated Premium account -> billing_and_subscription. A NAMED title/artist greyed out -> content_availability. 'Used somewhere else' -> account_security. A deliberate removal the customer names ('no longer supported', 'bring back') -> feature_request_and_feedback.
    e.g. "my (android) app freezes after it plays ads and I need to restart it every time to resume playing music"
    e.g. "having issues with app on Samsung s6. Every track skips like scratched CD? Checked w/ o apps, no issues so not hphones or fone"
- feature_request_and_feedback: The customer asks Spotify to build, change, restore or prioritise a capability that does not exist, or gives an opinion about product design, deliberate changes, ads, recommendations, shuffle, curated playlists, pricing policy or the company, with nothing broken and no account action needed.
    includes: 'Why don't you have X', 'bring back lyrics', named deprecations ('no longer supported'); sleep timer/alarm/block-artist/lossless/parental filter requests; platform requests (Apple Watch, Xbox); UI/default complaints; Discover Weekly/Daily Mix quality; shuffle not random; ads complaints with no paid wording; churn rants with no symptom.
    excludes: Capability exists -> how_to_and_product_question. Specific song/artist/country availability -> content_availability. Something that used to work and now fails with no deprecation wording -> app_or_playback_issue. Ads on a stated paid account -> billing_and_subscription. Praise with no ask -> other.
    e.g. "should have an alarm feature so I can wake up to my soundtrack every morning. Just saying......."
    e.g. "Bring back lyrics you monster"
- how_to_and_product_question: A question about how to use an existing capability, whether something is possible, what a feature or plan costs/covers, how to subscribe, or an intended-behaviour or policy explanation with a fixed public answer; no failed attempt or charge reported.
    includes: 'How do I copy a URI / clear my queue / use folders / sign out everywhere / stop autoplay'; 'can I keep downloads after the trial'; 'how much is a year'; 'how do I get Premium'; 'is there an Xbox app'; privacy settings; offline-device limit; 'how do I verify as a student'; 'can two people share Premium'; 'can I transfer Family ownership'; NUS vs UNiDAYS; regional promo eligibility.
    excludes: Capability does not exist -> feature_request_and_feedback. Answer depends on the customer's account/charges -> billing_and_subscription or account_access_and_settings. Artist tools -> artist_and_creator. Why a song is missing -> content_availability.
    e.g. "How do you copy URI on ?"
    e.g. "Does anyone know how to clear my queue on the iPhone App? I've clicked around this thing for an hour."
- support_followup_and_channel_request: The message is about the support interaction itself rather than a describable product problem: chasing an existing DM/email/ticket, asking to be contacted, asking for a phone number or other channel, or a bare 'account/premium issue' with no symptom.
    includes: 'Sent you a DM', 'check my DMs', 'I emailed three times, no response', 'still waiting since yesterday', 'please contact me', 'is there a phone number', 'having issues with my premium/account' with no symptom, 'worst customer service' about waiting; tweets containing the customer's email or account details.
    excludes: Any message that names a symptom, charge, login failure, hack or content title -> that intent, even with a channel ask attached. Artist senders chasing Artist Support -> artist_and_creator. Anger about the product with no support-process complaint -> feature_request_and_feedback.
    e.g. "Hi! Sent you a DM."
    e.g. "hello can someome answer my dms im gonna lose my premium"
- artist_and_creator: The sender is acting as an artist, label, podcaster or business partner about their own content, profile, stats, reports, submissions or applications ('my release', 'my song', 'our podcast', 'my verified page').
    includes: Release attached to the wrong/duplicate artist page for the sender's own act; Spotify for Artists access; verified profile; stream counts/reports to their aggregator; royalties/payouts; pitching their own release; podcast submission; partnership applications; chasing Artist Support.
    excludes: A listener reporting wrong data on someone else's artist page -> content_availability. Listener curation asks -> feature_request_and_feedback. Careers/job applications -> other.
    e.g. "had a release today that came out on Spotify and made a new artist page instead of attaching to my verified page! help pls <3"
    e.g. "I have an artist issue. DM me plz & thnx :("
- other: Catch-all: (a) praise/thanks/banter/shared links with nothing to fix; (b) vague pleas, image-only or fragment tweets with no diagnosable words; (c) off-topic asks with a fixed answer (careers, presale codes, follows, recommendations); (d) human-only requests (data export/GDPR, account deletion, bereavement, legal/press).
    includes: 'saved the day! Thank you!', 'never mind I fixed it', 'who has cool playlists?', 'I need help'/'SOS' with no device or symptom, 'here are some errors <pic>', '2/2 ...' fragments, 'do you have job openings', 'why didn't I get a presale code', 'I need all the data you have about me', 'delete my account'.
    excludes: Anything with even one concrete symptom, device, charge, login, hack, content title, feature wish or artist matter -> that intent. Vague message containing 'account', 'premium', 'subscription', 'plan', 'login', 'DM' or 'phone' -> support_followup_and_channel_request. 'How do I subscribe' -> how_to_and_product_question.
    e.g. "saved the day! ❤️ Thank you!"
    e.g. "Necesito ayuda / I need help"

Tie-breaks: Multi-intent precedence for the primary label: account_security > account_access_and_settings > billing_and_subscription > app_or_playback_issue > content_availability > artist_and_creator > feature_request_and_feedback > how_to_and_product_question > other; support_followup only when nothing describable is present or the customer explicitly chases. | Capability exists -> how_to_and_product_question; does not exist -> feature_request_and_feedback, regardless of phrasing (folders and collaborative playlists exist; block-artist, explicit filter, lossless, ad opt-out do not). | Plan question with no error and no charge -> how_to (auto); any error message, failed invite or charge -> billing (escalate). Hulu/partner bundle mentioned -> billing. | Logged in + error on the payment page -> billing; error at login -> account_access; login fails on one device only or 'you're offline' -> app_or_playback_issue. | Named artist/title won't play on every client -> content_availability; 'from my library/downloads' with no title -> app_or_playback_issue. | Download/offline wording -> app (auto first time on one device); songs/playlists/library gone with no download wording -> app, escalate; 'second time', 'always', 'new phone' -> escalate. | 'Used somewhere else' or unknown device/speaker -> account_security; known co-listener -> how_to. Unfamiliar music in Recently Played -> account_security; only in Discover Weekly -> feature_request. | 'Where did X go' with no attribution -> app_or_playback_issue; customer says it was removed/deprecated/'is this permanent' -> feature_request_and_feedback. | Country not launched -> content_availability; existing account abroad/VPN/14-day -> account_access_and_settings. | 'my release/song/podcast/verified page' -> artist_and_creator; listener report -> content (metadata) or feature (curation). | Vague message with an account/premium/subscription/plan/login/DM/phone keyword -> support_followup_and_channel_request; no keyword -> other; device or symptom named -> app_or_playback_issue.
